name: SOL favourite taker, model-edge entry
description: Buys the SOL favourite when the normal-model probability Phi(z) exceeds the ask by at least 3c (z>=1.0, ask<=95c), checkpoints 600..240 s, held to settlement. Entry depends on price relative to the spot-implied probability instead of a fixed z cut.
hypothesis: Dev screen (Jan-Sep, taker next fills net of fee, ask<=0.95): net return rises monotonically with Phi(z)-ask: -0.05..0 +0.3c, 0..0.03 +0.8c, 0.03..0.06 +2.0c (1,278), >0.06 +2.8c (605). The market under-prices settled-ness most where it is furthest below the model. Wrong if full <+1c/CI incl. 0 or the sol-zfav family decay (lockbox 0 for sol-zfav-px) repeats; honest prior is that it does, since it is the same family.
